title: Kenworth T610 FUPS Compatable Road Train Hi-tensile Aluminium Bullbar #55
description: Kenworth T610 Radar Compatible Custom Built high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS compliant Road Train Bullbar. 76mm diameter high tensile tube welded into drilled uprights for maximum strength, no butt welds resulting in maximum protection. Heavy duty high tensile box uprights with internal welds for maximum strength and custom designed heavy duty extended fully reinforced main channel. Reversible Road Train/Long Vehicle signs. Heavy duty main channel mounted on a hi-tensile aluminium backing plate with 35mm tow pin. Driving light mounts fitted to customer requirements including custom centre light bar mount. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
